utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Eli, the repair drive’s really picking up—folks on Maple already dropped off a good stack of tools, and Mara’s setting up a sorting table so drop-offs should be easy.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good—that gives us a clear start. I’ll put together the drop-off timing and sorting plan this afternoon so we can keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s wonderful, Eli—once you’ve got the timing set, I’ll keep spreading the word so folks know exactly when to bring their lamps and radios by.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late—how’s the repair drive going, and where can I jump in?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It’s this Saturday afternoon, and I’ve been telling everyone so we get a good turnout—if you can, jump in by helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’ll start spreading the word today, and I can still pitch in on Saturday if you need extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I only know a couple parts so far—Sam’s covering bike repairs, and Lila’s bringing tools. I’m still checking with the others one by one before I say anything beyond that.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds like a solid start. I can send over a quick list from my basic toolkit if that helps fill any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that would help—a quick list would make it easier for me to see what we’re still missing before I check with everyone else.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep — I’m still on for Saturday at 10 by the community shed, and I’ll bring a few basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Bo—I’ve got Saturday at 10 by the community shed noted, and I’ll keep the repair drive details separate at the community center lot this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—I'm just tracking Saturday at 10 by the community shed for the repair drive, and I’ll bring my basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming together nicely—people from a few different blocks showed up, so it feels like a real neighborhood effort.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That’s good to hear—before we get too far, do we have the day pinned down yet, or are we still choosing between Saturday and Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We’re still deciding, but Saturday seems to be getting a little more traction so far. I’m trying to check in with a couple more people before we lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, timing first—I keep losing the thread otherwise. Are we still choosing between Saturday and Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yeah, it’s still between Saturday and Sunday—I’m leaning Saturday, but I can make either work.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday makes sense, yeah—if we lock that in, I can stop circling and we can sort volunteers next.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Any word yet on the plan and timing for the repair drive? I can check it between stops.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep — Sam’s in to tackle the wobbly chairs and help with a busted lamp, and I’m bringing my tools; I’m aiming to get folks set up by late morning.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, that works—send me the final timing if anything shifts, and I’ll check it between stops.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good—once the workspace is set, I’ll get started on the chairs and then check out the lamp.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect—meet at the community shed Saturday at 10, and bring any basic tools you’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it, Leo—I’ll be there at 10 with my basic tools and ready to start on those chairs.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think we should confirm the date first, and also who’s actually bringing the tools, before we rely on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Date matters, but Lila already said she’s bringing tools—what I still need is the full job list and who’s covering each one.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, but I’d still feel better once the date is locked and the job list is written out so we know who’s covering what.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Cleo, the repair drive’s really gaining steam, so I’m spreading the word on Cedar and Pine this afternoon. Tell folks Mara’s got a sorting table set up, so they can just bring their busted lamps and radios right over.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect—I’ll keep the basic kit by Mara’s table and make sure the screws and patch supplies stay organized for whoever comes by.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Cleo—that’ll make it easy for people to jump in, and I’ll keep sending neighbors your way this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: If you can confirm the start time, I can work it around school pickup on my end.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, I think Cleo said she’s taking the lead, but I should double-check the start time for you. In the meantime, I can still help sort screws and patch supplies.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Oren—I’d appreciate that, since I’m trying to plan around school pickup, and it’s great that you can help with supplies in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell — I’m pulling the repair drive together now; could you tell me what tools or volunteer help you might be able to offer so I can match it to the biggest gaps?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard from Vik that it’s this Saturday afternoon, so I’m still a little out of the loop, but I can probably lend a hand if you tell me what you’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s helpful, Nell—thank you. Right now I’m trying to fill a couple of steady volunteer slots and confirm who can bring basic repair tools, so if you can tell me what you’re comfortable helping with, I’ll match you where it’s most useful.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
